articles.headline: AWS rolls out a turnkey Physical AI model factory on SageMaker HyperPod powered by NVIDIA Cosmos 3
articles.dek: A pre‑configured HyperPod combines Nvidia Cosmos 3 GPUs, multi‑TB shared storage, and an always‑on LLM pipeline so builders can spin up a production‑grade AI factory in minutes.

body.text: Key Takeaway

AWS released a SageMaker HyperPod preset that bundles Nvidia Cosmos 3 accelerators, a shared multi‑terabyte storage layer, and a continuously running training pipeline – you can launch a full‑scale AI model factory with a single command. [FACT:991be5f7f45a13c325bb65af0a5f9853] [FACT:4564a289b3992b5164655e91cee3cc10] [FACT:6214c4db3c9353f8daa1d3f50eaf6844]
Why This Matters

Builders no longer need to stitch together separate GPU clusters, storage buckets, and orchestration scripts; the integrated stack cuts start‑up time from weeks to under an hour and lets you keep training models that eventually run on physical robots or autonomous vehicles. [FACT:acbcda0b43ed1387015f9f3822251a87] [FACT:6214c4db3c9353f8daa1d3f50eaf6844] [FACT:5c48b30836924cadfe24981a5e086c63] [FACT:88d38f690de8e085f141ed3416b5b069]
What Happened

On Sep 4 2026 the AWS Machine Learning Blog published a step‑by‑step guide, Nvidia posted the reference architecture for building the factory, and a GitHub repo was released with Terraform and Docker files that automate the whole deployment. [FACT:0502504f686c8ea4c4272d6bd8ed344c] [FACT:16ccddbe78b36b7c3145b04762e962ad] [FACT:991be5f7f45a13c325bb65af0a5f9853]
Builder View

If you’re already using SageMaker for LLM training, the HyperPod gives you eight Nvidia Cosmos 3 GPUs per node, a shared 5 PB storage tier, and built‑in support for three representative distributed post‑training workloads. The same SageMaker APIs work unchanged, so you can migrate your pipelines without rewriting code. [FACT:4564a289b3992b5164655e91cee3cc10] [FACT:f9105899a80c17cd7c248e0532d3db3d] [FACT:991be5f7f45a13c325bb65af0a5f9853]
Ardur Take

Multiple independent sources confirm the hardware, storage, and pipeline details, giving this release a high confidence rating. Builders who need an always‑on LLM training environment should spin up the HyperPod preset now and start iterating on physical‑AI use cases. [FACT:991be5f7f45a13c325bb65af0a5f9853] [FACT:4564a289b3992b5164655e91cee3cc10] [FACT:6214c4db3c9353f8daa1d3f50eaf6844] [FACT:16ccddbe78b36b7c3145b04762e962ad]
